intro.mode.classic.title: Classic
intro.mode.classic.desc: See every value and change the current legend up to 5 times.
intro.mode.purist.title: Purist
intro.mode.purist.desc: Values stay hidden and there are no swaps. Your football knowledge decides.
intro.title: Create your player, build the attributes and become a legend
intro.body: Choose a position, complete eight draft rounds with football legends and play a career full of contracts, transfers, injuries, trophies and decisions.
intro.disclaimer: Independent football career simulator. Not affiliated with clubs or players.
intro.how.title: Eight attributes define the ceiling of your career
intro.how.body: Each round gives you a legend. The game takes their best attribute you have not used yet. Complete PAC, SHO, PAS, DRI, DEF, PHY, SKL and WF, then your position determines your potential.
intro.how.identity.title: Create your player
intro.how.identity.body: Choose surname, number, preferred foot, country and position.
intro.how.draft.title: Complete the draft
intro.how.draft.body: Take a different attribute from eight legends and build your player card.
intro.how.career.title: Play the career
intro.how.career.body: Sign contracts, move clubs, win trophies and chase an S career grade.
intro.faq.title: Copero game FAQ
intro.faq.free.a: Yes. It runs directly in your browser and requires no account.
intro.faq.mode.q: What is the difference between Classic and Purist?
intro.faq.mode.a: Classic shows the values and gives you five legend swaps. Purist hides the values and gives you no swaps.
intro.faq.potential.a: Each position uses different attribute weights. A striker depends more on shooting and pace; a centre-back depends more on defending and physical.
intro.faq.save.a: Yes. Progress is stored locally in this browser and restored when you return.
identity.title: Define your identity
identity.subtitle: Nationality, position and playing identity.
identity.helper: Choose nationality and position. A default is selected so you can continue immediately and change it if you want.
identity.heritageHint: Parent nationality · may unlock another national team
identity.pitchHint: Tap any position on the pitch to change it.

draft.body: Each legend can contribute one attribute. Confirmed attributes are locked.
draft.puristBody: The game will take this legend's best available attribute. The value is revealed after confirmation.
draft.back: Back to identity and restart draft
draftResult.title: Your future has a shape now
draftResult.body: Potential is calculated from your position and the eight drafted attributes. It is your player's development ceiling during the career.
origin.title: Choose between three paths
origin.body: The choices depend on your nationality and draft potential. A smaller club offers minutes; a stronger club offers exposure and trophies, but more competition for a place.
origin.empty: No available clubs were found for this nationality. Go back and choose another nationality.
origin.preview.big.risk: You may stay on the bench
traits.title: Your playing style
traits.body: Choose up to 2 traits. They affect events, offers and development.
trait.ambitious.label: Ambitious
trait.ambitious.desc: More upward moves and less patience at smaller clubs.
trait.loyal.label: Loyal
trait.loyal.desc: More renewals and local status; fewer early exits.
trait.party_risk.label: Nightlife
trait.party_risk.desc: More risky events and scandals, with occasional creative streaks.
trait.professional.label: Professional
trait.professional.desc: Better development and fewer avoidable injuries.
trait.media_magnet.label: Media magnet
trait.media_magnet.desc: More press attention: opportunities and pressure.
